description: A cold, dark kitchen with exposed wooden beams. The stove is out, and a chill hangs in the air. Dried herbs dangle from the ceiling, their scent faint in the cold. A large oak table sits in the center, covered with a checkered cloth.

exits.description: A wooden door that has a small sigh of Bath on it.
A classic double swinging door with a small round window, gently swaying.
A heavy wooden trapdoor set into the kitchen floor, its iron ring cold against the floorboards. A sturdy ladder disappears into darkness below.

items.name: apple
items.description: A crisp red apple, still cool from the cellar. Juicy and fresh.

items.name: water_pitcher
items.description: A clay pitcher filled with cool, clear water. Condensation beads on the surface.

items.name: kindling
items.description: A small bundle of dry twigs, perfect for starting a fire.

items.name: bread
items.description: A fresh loaf of crusty bread wrapped in a cloth. cold

items.name: medicine_cabinet
items.description: A small wooden cabinet mounted on the wall near the stove. Inside: a vial of antiseptic and some bandages.

items.name: locked_cabinet
items.description: A wall-mounted pantry cabinet with a sturdy brass lock. The keyhole suggests a small cabinet key would fit.

name: Kitchen
